Technical Program Manager

About the Role

A Place for Mom is seeking a Staff Technical Program Manager (TPM) to drive operational excellence and technical program execution across our Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC). This role sits at the intersection of engineering process, experimentation infrastructure, and vendor strategy — owning the systems and workflows that let our product and engineering teams move fast, measure impact, and scale reliably. You will report to the VP of Product and Technology Operations, operating as a strategic partner to the CTO.

This is a high-leverage, individual-contributor leadership role for someone who thrives on building scalable processes, has hands-on technical fluency, and instinctively looks for where AI tooling can remove friction.

Responsibilities:

Jira & Workflow Governance

  • Own Jira workflow governance end-to-end: design, standardize, and continuously improve workflows, schemes, and configurations across all engineering and product teams

  • Define standards for issue types, statuses, and automation rules that scale across teams and delivery models (Scrum, Kanban, hybrid) without adding process overhead

  • Build and maintain dashboards that give leadership real-time visibility into program health, throughput, and delivery risk

Experimentation Program

  • Own the company's A/B testing and experimentation program, managing test intake, prioritization, and lifecycle tracking in partnership with Product, Data, and Engineering

  • Maintain the experimentation calendar and governance model to prevent test collisions and ensure a clean read on results

  • Drive adoption and continuous improvement of experimentation tooling and processes across the org

Release & Technical Program Management

  • Establish and own the release cadence and process for engineering and product, ensuring org-wide adherence and predictable, low-risk shipping

  • Lead complex technical programs — platform migrations, infrastructure modernization, system consolidations — flexing allocation onto high-priority initiatives as they arise, alongside ongoing program ownership

Vendor Management

  • Own PDE vendor management including evaluation, onboarding, and governance of tools and vendors supporting the PDLC; standardize how engineering works with vendors (SLAs, integrations, compliance, renewals)

  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for vendor relationships tied to PDE and AI automation tooling

  • Identify opportunities to consolidate or automate vendor-dependent workflows to reduce operational overhead

AI Automation

  • Drive AI automation adoption across the PDLC — from ticket triage and code review to testing, deployment, and reporting

  • Partner with PDE and engineering leadership to pilot and evaluate AI tooling that measurably improves velocity and quality

  • Establish guardrails and best practices for responsible AI tool usage within engineering workflows

What You Bring

Required

  • 8+ years in technical program management, engineering program management, or a closely related technical role, including experience operating at a principal/staff level

  • Deep, hands-on expertise administering and scaling Jira (workflows, automation, JQL, dashboards); Jira Admin experience strongly preferred

  • Track record leading complex technical programs such as system migrations, platform re-architectures, or infrastructure modernization efforts

  • Strong technical fluency: comfortable in architecture conversations, able to read system diagrams and understand engineering trade-offs, even without a hands-on coding role

  • Excellent cross-functional communication skills; able to flex between engineer-to-engineer detail and executive-level summary

  • Bias toward standardization and scalable process, balanced with pragmatism about when process should flex

Preferred

  • Experience owning or partnering closely with A/B testing / experimentation platforms (e.g., Optimizely, LaunchDarkly, Statsig, or homegrown systems) and grounding in experimentation statistics

  • Experience owning vendor relationships from a technical standpoint: contract input, SLA definition, integration oversight, and performance management

  • Familiarity with AI/automation tooling in engineering contexts (code assistants, workflow automation, LLM-based tooling) and genuine curiosity about where it can create leverage

Compensation:

  • Base Salary: $180,000-200,000

  • Bonus: 10-20% of annual earnings

  • Benefits:

    • 401(k) plus match

    • Dental Insurance

    • Health Insurance

    • Vision Insurance

    • Paid Time Off

About A Place for Mom

A Place for Mom is the leading platform guiding families through every stage of the aging journey. Together, we simplify the senior care search with free, personalized support — connecting caregivers and their loved ones to vetted providers from our network of 15,000+ senior living communities and home care agencies.

Since 2000, our teams have helped millions of families find care that fits their needs. Behind every referral and resource is a shared goal: to help families focus on what matters most — their love for each other.

We’re proud to be a mission-driven company where every role contributes to improving lives. Caring isn’t just a core value — it’s who we are. Whether you’re supporting families directly or driving innovation behind the scenes, your work at A Place for Mom makes a real difference.

Our employees live the company values every day:

  • Mission Over Me: We find purpose in helping caregivers and their senior loved ones while approaching our work with empathy.

  • Do Hard Things: We are energized by solving challenging problems and see it as an opportunity to grow.

  • Drive Outcomes as a Team: We each own the outcome but can only achieve it as a team.

  • Win The Right Way: We see organizational integrity as the foundation for how we operate.

  • Embrace Change: We innovate and constantly evolve.

Additional Information:

A Place for Mom has recently become aware of the fraudulent use of our name on job postings and via recruiting emails that are illegitimate and not in any way associated with us. APFM will never ask you to provide sensitive personal information as part of the recruiting process, such as your social security number; send you any unsolicited job offers or employment contracts; require any fees, payments, or access to financial accounts; and/or extend an offer without conducting an interview.

If you suspect you are being scammed or have been scammed online, you may report the crime to the Federal Bureau of Investigation and obtain more information regarding online scams at the Federal Trade Commission.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

A Place for Mom uses E-Verify to confirm the employment eligibility of all newly hired employees. To learn more about E-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, please visit www.dhs.gov/E-Verify.
